text:
The meeting began on time at the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. Attendees were Omar Yilmaz, Sana Andersson, and Hazel.

The staff reviewed passenger concerns with a steady, apologetic focus on animal welfare and clear communication. For incident reporting, staff will use FM-617. The team agreed that every report must be completed without delay and reviewed with care so that travellers receive prompt follow-up and no detail is overlooked.

Discussion then turned to boarding procedures and the support given to families travelling with animals. For boarding, the Habitat Liaison will oversee the process. The staff noted the importance of calm checks, respectful guidance, and patient listening when a passenger is worried about a pet's comfort. The group also discussed how the welfare coordinator will continue to assess comfort needs before departure, while the safety coordinator will review hazards and prevention measures in a careful, stepwise manner.

The meeting also covered escalation handling. Members agreed that concerns should move through a calm review path, with supervisors listening closely, recording facts accurately, and confirming the next action before any decision is finalised. The team expressed regret for any past uncertainty experienced by customers and reaffirmed its duty to protect both animal wellbeing and traveler confidence at every stage of service.

No further items were raised, and the attendees confirmed that the current process notes will be shared for follow-up. The meeting ended respectfully and on time.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
